x-m-h1-07.title: Layin zai taɓa da’irar kuwa? Bayani yana bayyana ɗaya bayan ɗaya.
x-m-h1-07.goal: Hasashen matsayin layi da da’ira bisa ƙimar tsayayyen lamba k, sake duba hukuncinka da sabon bayani, sannan ka takaita zangon k da zai sa layi ya zama tangenti.
x-m-h1-07.material: Akwai da’ira x²+y²=25 (tsakiya a asali, radius 5) da layi y=x+k. Sauya ƙimar k, sannan ka duba yawan wuraren da layin da da’irar suka haɗu.
x-m-h1-07.thinking.1: Sake duba hasashenka da sabon bayani.
x-m-h1-07.prereq.1: Alaƙar yawan mafita idan aka warware lissafin layi da da’ira tare da yawan wuraren haɗuwarsu
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.prompt: Duk lokacin da aka bayyana ƙimar k, yi hasashe sannan ka zaɓi yawan wuraren haɗuwa ko ƙimar tangenti.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.hint.0: Za ka iya bincika yawan wuraren haɗuwa ta amfani da mafitar lissafin da ake samu idan aka warware lissafin layi da na da’ira tare.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.hint.1: Ka kuma rubuta hanyar kwatanta tazarar daga asali zuwa layi da girman radius.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.info: Idan k=1 ne, layin y=x+1 ne. (Tsayin inda yake yanke ginshiƙin y, wato 1, ya fi radius 5 ƙasa.)
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.ask: Layin da da’irar za su haɗu a maki nawa?
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.after: x²+(x+1)²=25 yana sauƙaƙa zuwa x²+x−12=0, don haka x=−4, 3 ne, kuma wuraren haɗuwa su ne (−4, −3), (3, 4), guda 2 gaba ɗaya. Layi da ya ratsa cikin da’ira (kusa da asali) kullum yana haɗuwa da da’irar a maki biyu.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan yana nuna tunanin cewa layin da ya ratsa cikin da’ira yana haɗuwa da ita a wurare biyu.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan hukunci ne cewa layin yana wajen da’ira. Ka yi tunanin tazarar daga asali zuwa layin.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan hukunci ne cewa layin tangenti ne. Ka yi tunanin cewa layin yana wucewa kusa da wani wuri a cikin da’ira, wato asali.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.info: An ɗaga k zuwa 7. Layin y=x+7 yana haɗuwa da ginshiƙin y a (0, 7), kuma 7 ya fi radius 5 girma.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.after: x²+(x+7)²=25 yana sauƙaƙa zuwa x²+7x+12=0, don haka x=−3, −4 ne, wuraren haɗuwa kuma (−3, 4), (−4, 3), guda 2 ne gaba ɗaya. Tazarar daga asali zuwa layin x−y+7=0 ita ce 7/√2 (7 bisa tushen 2) ≈ 4.95, wadda ta fi radius 5 ƙasa. Ko da tsayin y-intercept ya fi 5, layin yana karkata, don haka zai iya isa da’irar.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Idan ka yanke hukunci ta tsayin y-intercept kaɗai, za ka iya kasa lura da tasirin karkatar layin. Ka yi la’akari da tazarar daga asali zuwa layin.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Dole a duba ko layin tangenti ne ta amfani da tazara ko discriminant. Za ka iya lissafa shi.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wannan tunani ne na duba yadda layin yake kusa da da’ira, ba tsayin y-intercept kaɗai ba. Hukunci ne da ke shakkar cewa hasashe da lissafi na iya bambanta.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.info: Lokacin da k=7 akwai wuraren haɗuwa 2; idan aka ɗaga k zuwa 8, babu wurin haɗuwa.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.ask: Wace ƙimar k tabbatacciya ce da za ta sa layin ya zama tangenti ga da’irar?
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.after: Idan layin tangenti ne, tazarar daga asali zuwa layin x−y+k=0, wato |k|/√2, ita ce 5, don haka k=5√2≈7.07. Hanyar discriminant ma tana ba da, daga 2x²+2kx+k²−25=0, D/4=50−k²=0, saboda haka k²=50. A 7.5, D/4=50−56.25<0, don haka ba sa haɗuwa.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Kwatanta da bayanin cewa akwai wuraren haɗuwa 2 tun a k=7.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Ya dace da bayanin cewa ƙimar tana tsakanin 7 da 8. Amma ka lissafa ko tazarar k/√2 tsakanin asali da layin a wannan k ta fi ko ta yi ƙasa da 5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Sake duba bayanin cewa k=7. 6 ya fi ƙasa da 7.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wannan hukunci ne da ya haɗa bayanai biyu tare da amfani da gaskiyar cewa ƙimar tangenti tana tsakanin 7 da 8.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.st.2.r.e: Yana da kama da gaskiya, amma ka duba ko tazarar tsakanin asali da layin a k=7.5 ta fi ko ta yi ƙasa da 5.
x-m-h1-07.s.s1.reflect: Da farko ya yi kama da cewa a k=7, inda y-intercept ya fi radius, ba za su haɗu ba; amma a zahiri sun haɗu a wurare biyu. Wane bayani ya sa ka sake duba hasashenka? Wane bincike za ka iya saba yi don kada hasashe ya ruɗe ka?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.prompt: Ga k=7, ka bayyana dalilin da tunanin farko “y-intercept ya fi radius, saboda haka ba sa haɗuwa” yake kuskure, ta amfani da tazarar layi daga asali ko ma’aunin wuraren haɗuwa.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.hint.0: Sake tunanin sifar layin da ba ka yi la’akari da ita a tunaninka na farko ba.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.hint.1: Rubuta lissafin da za a samu idan aka warware layi da da’ira tare a k=7, sannan ka bincika mafita.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Idan ka duba y-intercept kaɗai, ...
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka haɗa dalilin da y-intercept kaɗai bai isa ba da yadda layin ya karkata?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka rubuta ƙimomin da ka lissafa (tazara ko wuraren haɗuwa) a matsayin lambobi?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana da wannan hanyar dalilin da ba sa haɗuwa a k=8 ma?
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.0: Dole ne in daina duba y-intercept kaɗai. Layin ya karkata, kuma tazarar daga asali zuwa layin, 7/√2≈4.95, ta fi radius 5 ƙasa, saboda haka suna haɗuwa. A gaskiya, (−3, 4) da (−4, 3) su ne wuraren haɗuwa.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.1: Idan layi ya karkata, zai iya isa da’irar ko da wurin da yake yanke ginshiƙin y yana wajen da’ira ne. Idan aka warware su tare, x²+7x+12=0 yana ba da x=−3, −4, saboda haka sun haɗu a wurare biyu.
x-m-h1-07.s.s2.model.2: Warware y=x+7 da x²+y²=25 tare yana ba da x²+7x+12=0, saboda haka x=-3, -4. Don haka ko da y-intercept ya fi 5, suna haɗuwa a wurare biyu.

x-m-h1-01.title: A ina ne mafita ta ragowa ta yi kuskure?
x-m-h1-01.goal: Nemo layin da ba daidai ba a mafitar da ke nemo ragowa, gyara shi, sannan ka gwada amsar da ba daidai ba da sharadin farko domin tabbatar da kuskuren.
x-m-h1-01.material: Wannan ita ce mafitar Minjae don nemo madaidaicin a ta yadda ragowar za ta zama 6 idan aka raba f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 da x+1. (x³ yana nufin x a ɗaga zuwa 3, kuma ax² yana nufin a sau da x murabba’i.)
x-m-h1-01.thinking.0: Karanta mafitar gaba ɗaya sannan ka nemo layin farko da ba daidai ba.
x-m-h1-01.thinking.1: Gyara kuskuren ka nemo sabuwar amsa.
x-m-h1-01.thinking.2: Saka amsar da ba daidai ba cikin sharadin ka duba sabanin da ya fito.
x-m-h1-01.prereq.0: Ka san alaƙar da ke tsakanin ragowar da ake samu idan aka raba furuci mai canji da furuci na layi, da darajar furucin.
x-m-h1-01.prereq.1: Lissafi da furuci masu haruffa (haɗa kalmomi masu kama)
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin farko a mafitar Minjae da ba daidai ba.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.hint.0: Sake rubuta x+1 ta yadda mai rabawa zai kasance a sigar x−(wani adadi).
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta wannan adadin da darajar da ka saka cikin f.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.line.0: Ragowar idan aka raba f(x)=x³+ax²+x+2 da x+1 ita ce 6.
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.line.1: A ka’idar ragowa, ragowar idan aka raba da x+1 ita ce f(1).
x-m-h1-01.s.s1.explain: Layi na 2 ba daidai ba ne. Ana iya rubuta x+1 a matsayin x−(−1), don haka ragowar ita ce f(−1), ba f(1) ba. Layi na 3 da 4 kawai suna bin layi na 2, saboda haka lissafin da ke cikinsu daidai ne, amma sakamakonsu ba daidai ba ne.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.prompt: Gyara layin da ba daidai ba sannan ka nemo darajar a. Sannan ka kuma rubuta ragowar da za a samu idan aka saka a=2 na Minjae cikin f(x) aka raba da x+1, domin nuna dalilin da ya sa amsar Minjae ba ta aiki.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko, rubuta darajar x da ke sa x+1=0.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.hint.1: Saka darajar a da ka nemo ta amfani da gyaran layi, da a=2 na Minjae, cikin f(x), sannan ka kwatanta ragowar.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: A mafitar da aka gyara, ka lissafta f(−1) kai tsaye?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka lissafta ragowar idan a=2, ka nuna cewa ba 6 ba ne?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Za ka iya bayyana yadda binciken ya nuna kuskuren mafitar?
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.model.0: x+1=x−(−1), saboda haka ragowar ita ce f(−1). f(−1)=−1+a−1+2=a, kuma wannan ya zama 6, don haka a=6. Idan na saka a=2 na Minjae, f(−1)=2 ne, saboda haka ba 6 ba ne.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.model.1: Idan ana raba da x+1, dole ne in saka x=−1, saboda haka f(−1)=a. Ragowar ita ce 6, don haka a=6. Dubawa: idan a=2, to f(−1)=−1+2−1+2=2, saboda haka bai cika sharadin ba.
x-m-h1-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Dubawa da darajar daidai (idan a=6, to f(−1)=6) ma hanya ce mai kyau.

x-m-h1-02.title: Ƙirƙiri rashin daidaiton murabba’i mai mafita integer guda 3 daidai.
x-m-h1-02.goal: Fahimci sharadin da rashin daidaiton murabba’i zai sami mafita integer guda 3 daidai ta hanyar wuraren tushensa biyu, sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalai daban-daban ka gwada su.
x-m-h1-02.material: Akwai rashin daidaiton murabba’i x²+bx+c<0 (x murabba’i da b x da c ya yi ƙasa da 0). b da c lambobi ne na integer, kuma ana son a sami integer x guda 3 daidai da ke cika wannan rashin daidaito. A kira tushen biyun α (alpha) da β (beta), daga ƙarami zuwa babba.
x-m-h1-02.thinking.0: Mayar da sharadin zuwa wuraren tushen biyun.
x-m-h1-02.thinking.1: Yi tunanin yadda iyakar (< ko ≤) ke da muhimmanci.
x-m-h1-02.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misalai da dama da suka cika sharadin.
x-m-h1-02.prereq.0: Alaƙar da ke tsakanin tushen daidaiton murabba’i da wurin da jadawalin aikin murabba’i yake haɗuwa da axis na x.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.prompt: Idan akwai mafita integer guda 3 daidai, menene dole ne ya zama gaskiya koyaushe game da bambancin β−α na tushen biyun?
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.hint.0: Yi tunanin rashin daidaito ɗaya wanda mafitar ta kasance 0, 1, 2, da ɗaya wadda mafitar ta kasance −1, 0, 1, sannan ka zana wuraren da tushen suke.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.hint.1: Yi tunanin wuraren da tushen dole ne su kasance domin integer da ke kusa da mafita ta integer (misali −1 da 3 idan mafita 0, 1, 2 ce) su zama marasa mafita.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.a: Wannan na iya zama tunani ne bisa tushen integer kaɗai kamar (−1, 3). Gwada ko tushen da ba integer ba ma zai yiwu.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.b: A iyaka, < da ≤ na iya canzawa. Ka yi tunanin misalin da mafita 0, 1, 2 ce kuma tushen su ne −1 da 3.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.c: Wannan tunani yana sanya mafita integer guda 3 a tsakanin tushen biyun, sannan ya yi la’akari da yiwuwar a ƙarshen biyu.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.r.d: Dole ne a yi la’akari daban da adadin mafita integer da kuma ko bambancin tushen integer ne. Gwada rashin daidaito kamar x²−3<0.
x-m-h1-02.s.s1.explain: Idan integer masu jere n, n+1, n+2 mafita ne, to α<n kuma β>n+2, don haka β−α>2. Haka kuma, n−1 da n+3 ba mafita ba ne, saboda haka α≥n−1 kuma β≤n+3, wanda ya ba da β−α≤4. Wannan na iya faruwa ko da tushen ba integers ba ne, don haka bambancin ba dole ne ya zama integer ba (mafitar x²−3<0 ita ce −1, 0, 1).
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi integers b da c domin ƙirƙirar rashin daidaiton murabba’i x²+bx+c<0 guda 3 daban-daban, kowannensu yana da mafita integer guda 3 daidai.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko, faɗaɗa furuci mai murabba’i da tushen integer, (x−p)(x−q)<0, domin nemo b da c. Ƙirga adadin mafita integer.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.hint.1: Gwada ko hakan zai yiwu idan tushen ba integers ba ne. Ka yi tunanin yadda za a ƙirga integers da ke tsakanin tushen a wannan yanayin.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne b da c su zama integers.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Akwai tushen real guda biyu daban-daban.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Babu tushen real guda biyu daban-daban (babu mafita, ko kuma saitin mafita babu komai).
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.fail.c3: Adadin mafita integer ba 3 ba ne.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.explain: x²−2x−3<0 yana nufin (x+1)(x−3)<0, saboda haka −1<x<3, kuma mafita integer su ne 0, 1, 2. x²−4x<0 yana ba da 0<x<4, don haka 1, 2, 3. x²−3<0 yana ba da −√3<x<√3, don haka −1, 0, 1. x²−x−6<0 yana da mafita integer 4, −1, 0, 1, 2, saboda haka bai dace ba.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi ɗaya daga misalanka mai tushen integer da ɗaya mai tushen da ba integer ba, sannan ka bayyana yadda ƙirga mafita integer ya yi kama da yadda ya bambanta.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: A misalin da tushen integer ne, ka yi tunanin ko tushen da kansu suna cikin mafita.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: A misalin da tushen ba integers ba ne, ka tuna yadda ka ƙirga mafita integer.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.placeholder: misali, a misalin da tushen integer ne, ...
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi dalilin da ya sa ba a ƙirga tushen da kansu a matsayin mafita a misalin da tushen integer ne?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka faɗi cewa ana amfani da hanya ɗaya (ƙirga integers tsakanin tushen biyun) ko da tushen ba integers ba ne?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka ƙirga ɗaya bayan ɗaya domin tabbatar da cewa misalinka yana da mafita integer guda 3 daidai?
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan tushen integers ne (−1 da 3), alamar ita ce <, don haka tushen kansu ba mafita ba ne, kuma ina ƙirga 0, 1, 2 da ke tsakaninsu kawai. Idan tushen ba integers ba ne (−√3 da √3), ba sai na damu da tushen ba domin su ba integers ba ne, kuma ina ƙirga integers da ke tsakanin tushen biyun, −1, 0, 1.
x-m-h1-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Ƙirga integers da ke tsakanin tushen biyun hanya ɗaya ce. Bambancin shi ne idan tushen integers ne, dole ne a duba dabam cewa ba a haɗa tushen cikin mafita ba; amma idan ba integers ba ne, ba a buƙatar wannan dubawar.

x-m-h1-03.title: Me kake buƙatar sani domin ka ce tushen biyun masu kyau ne?
x-m-h1-03.goal: Zaɓi bayanin da ake buƙata da gaske domin a kammala cewa tushen biyun na daidaiton murabba’i lambobin real masu kyau ne, sannan ka yi amfani da misalan da ke karya ra’ayi domin nuna cewa wani ɓangare na bayanin shi kaɗai bai isa ba.
x-m-h1-03.material: Akwai daidaiton murabba’i x²+bx+c=0 (x murabba’i da b x da c sun yi daidai da 0, inda b da c lambobin real ne). Ana son a bayyana cewa tushen biyun lambobin real masu kyau ne (idan tushen biyun iri ɗaya ne, wannan tushen ma mai kyau ne). Ana iya ba ka wasu daga cikin bayanan da ke ƙasa.
x-m-h1-03.thinking.0: Zaɓi bayanan da ake buƙata da waɗanda ba a buƙata.
x-m-h1-03.thinking.1: Nuna cewa akwai misalin da ke karya ra’ayi idan bayanin bai isa ba.
x-m-h1-03.thinking.2: Haɗa dangantakar da ke tsakanin sharuɗɗan (jimilla, ninkin, tushen lamba na gaske).
x-m-h1-03.prereq.0: Ka san dangantakar da ke tsakanin tushen lamba biyu na x²+bx+c=0 da ƙimomin b da c.
x-m-h1-03.prereq.1: Ka san sharadin da lissafin murabba'i ke buƙata domin ya sami tushen lambobi na gaske.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi duk bayanan da suke da muhimmanci ƙwarai domin tabbatar da cewa tushen biyun lambobi ne tabbatattu na gaske. (Ya isa ka san duk abin da ake buƙata; kada ka zaɓi abin da ba a buƙata ba.)
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta alamun ninkin da jimillar tushen biyun idan tushen biyun tabbatattu ne.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.hint.1: Ka yi tunanin ko tushen na iya zama lambobi marasa gaske ko da ka san alamun jimilla da ninkin.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.o.a: b da c dukansu lambobi cikakku ne.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.a: Za ka ga cewa zama cikakkiyar lamba ko a'a ba shi da alaƙa kai tsaye da alamun tushen. Misali, x²−3x+1=0 yana da ƙimomin lissafi cikakku amma tushensa ba lambobi cikakku ba ne.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.o.b: b²−4c ≥ 0 (b murabba'i a cire 4c ya kai aƙalla 0).
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.b: Wannan yana nuna cewa dole ne ka fara duba ko tushen lambobi ne na gaske kafin ka yi magana game da alamunsu.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.c: Wannan ya juya sharadin cewa ninkin tushen biyun tabbatacce ne zuwa bayanai.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.d: Wannan ya juya sharadin cewa jimillar tushen biyun tabbatacciya ce zuwa bayanai.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.o.e: x=0 ba tushe ba ne na wannan lissafi.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.r.e: Wannan yana nufin c ba 0 ba ne. Ka yi tunanin ko wannan bayanin ya riga ya ƙunsa a cikin sauran bayanan.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.explain: Idan tushen biyun lambobi ne na gaske (b²−4c≥0), jimillar −b tabbatacciya ce, kuma ninkin c tabbatacce ne, to tushen biyun tabbatattu ne. Idan ninkin tabbatacce ne, tushen biyun suna da alama ɗaya; idan jimilla tabbatacciya ce, dukansu tabbatattu ne. Ba a buƙatar sanin ko b da c lambobi cikakku ne, kuma cewa x=0 ba tushe ba ne tuni yana cikin sharadin c>0.
x-m-h1-03.s.s1.acc.0: e ya riga ya biyo daga c>0, don haka ba lallai ba ne, amma ba bayanin da ya saɓa wa sauran ba ne. Daidai ne cewa ka zaɓi dukkan sassa uku na bayanin da ake buƙata.
x-m-h1-03.s.s2.prompt: Nuna cewa sanin biyu kawai daga cikin bayanan da ake buƙata bai isa ba. Ƙirƙiri lissafin murabba'i biyu waɗanda tushensu ke da jimilla tabbatacciya (−b>0) da ninkin tabbatacce (c>0), amma tushen ba na gaske ba ne (b²−4c<0), sannan ka shigar da b da c.

x-m-h1-06.title: Me ya sa dabarar faɗaɗa (A+B)² ta bambanta ga matiriksi?
x-m-h1-06.goal: Yi amfani da misalin da ya karyata ƙa'idar musanya wajen ninkar matiriksi, sannan ka bayyana tasirin hakan ga dabarun ninkawa.
x-m-h1-06.material: Ga lambobi, (a+b)²=a²+2ab+b² koyaushe yana aiki. Shin (A+B)²=A²+2AB+B² ma yana aiki ga matiriksi murabba'i A da B masu girma iri ɗaya? A nan A matiriksi 2×2 ne, layinsa na farko (1, 1), na biyu kuma (0, 1) ne; B matiriksi 2×2 ne, layinsa na farko (p, q), na biyu kuma (r, s) ne.
x-m-h1-06.thinking.0: Yanke shawarar sharadin da dabara za ta yi aiki a ƙarƙashinsa.
x-m-h1-06.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri takamaiman misalin da ya karyata da'awar.
x-m-h1-06.thinking.2: Bayyana tasirin misalin da ya karyata da'awar a kan dabara.
x-m-h1-06.prereq.0: Ma'anar tarawa da ninkawa ga matiriksi 2×2.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.hint.0: Faɗaɗa (A+B)(A+B) ta amfani da ƙa'idar rarrabawa, sannan ka rubuta dukkan sassan.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta furucin da aka faɗaɗa da A²+2AB+B², ka duba sassan da suka bambanta.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.o.a: Koyaushe yana aiki muddin A da B duka matiriksi murabba'i 2×2 ne.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.a: An ɗauka cewa ana iya amfani da ƙa'idodin ninkar lambobi ga matiriksi kai tsaye. Duba ko ana iya canza tsarin abubuwa a ninkar matiriksi.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.o.b: Yana aiki ne kawai idan A ko B matiriksi na asali ne ko matiriksi sifili.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.b: Gwada ko waɗannan ne kaɗai yanayin da dabara za ta yi aiki. Misali, ka yi tunanin A da A.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.o.c: Yana aiki idan AB=BA, amma akwai B da zai sa ya yi aiki ko da AB≠BA.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi daidai har zuwa cewa yana aiki idan AB=BA. Amma ka kwatanta sharadin da ake buƙata domin AB+BA da 2AB su yi daidai a furucin da aka faɗaɗa.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.o.d: Yana aiki idan AB=BA, kuma a wannan yanayin kaɗai.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.r.d: Wannan yana nuna tunanin faɗaɗa gefen hagu ta ƙa'idar rarrabawa, sannan a kwatanta inda ya bambanta da gefen dama.
x-m-h1-06.s.s1.explain: (A+B)²=(A+B)(A+B)=A²+AB+BA+B² ne; domin ya zama daidai da A²+2AB+B², muna buƙatar AB+BA=2AB, wato BA=AB. A ninkar matiriksi, AB da BA na iya zama ba daidai ba.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.prompt: Zaɓi lambobin cikakku p, q, r, s (kowannensu daga −9 zuwa 9) ta yadda AB da BA ba za su zama daidai ba. Ƙirƙiri B biyu dabam-dabam.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.hint.0: Lissafa kowace ƙima a AB da BA kai tsaye ta fuskar p, q, r, s.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙimomin da suke wuri ɗaya a cikin matiriks biyun, ka nemo inda suka bambanta.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.var.p: p (layi na 1, shafi na 1 na B).
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.var.q: q (layi na 1, shafi na 2 na B).
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.var.r: r (layi na 2, shafi na 1 na B).
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.var.s: s (layi na 2, shafi na 2 na B).
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Ƙimomin cikakkun lambobi ne daga −9 zuwa 9.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole ne ƙimomin su zama lambobi cikakku daga −9 zuwa 9.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.ok.c2: AB da BA sun bambanta (idan aka kwatanta ƙimomin wurare ɗaya ba su yi daidai ba).
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.fail.c2: AB da BA sun zama daidai. Lissafa ƙimomin samfurorin kai tsaye, sannan ka kwatanta su.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.explain: Ƙimomin AB su ne (p+r, q+s) a layi na farko da (r, s) a layi na biyu; na BA kuma su ne (p, p+q) a layi na farko da (r, r+s) a layi na biyu. Domin matiriks biyun su yi daidai, ana buƙatar r=0 da s=p; saboda haka idan r≠0 ko s≠p, AB≠BA. (p, q, r, s)=(3, 2, 0, 3) yana sa samfurorin biyun su yi daidai, don haka bai yi aiki ba.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi B guda ɗaya da ka ƙirƙira, nuna ƙima guda inda AB da BA suka bambanta, sannan ka rubuta tasirin hakan ga faɗaɗa (A+B)².
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.hint.0: Zaɓi ƙima guda inda AB da BA suka bambanta, sannan ka rubuta ƙimomin biyu gefe da gefe.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.hint.1: Rubuta sassan tsakiya biyu idan ka faɗaɗa (A+B)(A+B).
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.placeholder: Misali: Idan p=1, q=0, r=1, s=1, AB ...
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ka nuna da lambobi wani matsayi inda abubuwan da ke cikin AB da BA suka bambanta?
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin da ba za a iya haɗa AB+BA na cikin (A+B)² su zama 2AB ba?
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Ka sake duba lissafinka don B da ka zaɓa?
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan p=1, q=0, r=1, s=1, to wurin layi na 1, shafi na 1 na AB shi ne p+r=2, amma wurin layi na 1, shafi na 1 na BA shi ne p=1, saboda haka sun bambanta. Faɗaɗa (A+B)² yana ba da AB+BA, kuma tun da AB da BA suka bambanta, ba za a iya haɗa su su zama 2AB ba.
x-m-h1-06.s.s2.because.model.1: Dokar musanyawa ba ta aiki a nan, saboda haka AB da BA sun bambanta. Don haka (A+B)²=A²+AB+BA+B², kuma ba za a iya haɗa AB+BA su zama 2AB ba. Misali, idan p=0, q=1, r=1, s=0 ne, to a wurin layi na 2, shafi na 2 na AB, ƙimar s=0 ce; a wurin layi na 2, shafi na 2 na BA kuma, ƙimar r+s=1 ce.

x-m-h1-08.s.s1.line.0: Daga x²+y²−4x+6y−12=0, tara ɓangarorin x tare da na y: (x²−4x)+(y²+6y)=12.

x-m-h1-08.s.s2.hint.1: Zaɓi maki da ya matsa daga tsakiya a kwance ko a tsaye da tazarar radius, sannan ka saka shi cikin lissafin asali.

Radius ɗin shi ne 5, kuma maki (2, 2) yana da tazarar 5 sama da tsakiya, don haka yana kan da’irar; idan aka saka shi a lissafin asali ana samun 4+4−8+12−12=0, wanda ya dace.

x-m-h1-09.title: “Idan n² ma’auru ne, to n ma ma’auru ne” — wace hujja ce tabbatacciyar hujja?
x-m-h1-09.topic: Taruka da jimlolin gaskiya ko ƙarya
x-m-h1-09.goal: Kwatanta gwada misalai, tabbatar da akasin jimla, da tabbatar da sakamakon juyawa domin tantance wacce hanya ce ke nuna cewa jimlar gaskiya ce; sannan ka yi amfani da misali don bayyana cewa asalin jimla na iya zama ƙarya ko da akasinta gaskiya ce.
x-m-h1-09.material: Ɗalibai uku sun yi ƙoƙarin tabbatar da cewa jimlar “Idan n² ma’auru ne, to n ma ma’auru ne” game da cikakken adadi na halitta n gaskiya ce, sai suka ce haka. Sia: “Idan n=2, 4, 6 ne, n²=4, 16, 36 ne kuma n ma ma’auru ne, saboda haka gaskiya ce.” Doyun: “Akasinta, ‘Idan n ma’auru ne, to n² ma’auru ne,’ gaskiya ce: a ce n=2k, to n²=4k²=2(2k²). Saboda haka asalin jimlar ma gaskiya ce.” Jihu: “Sakamakon juyawa, ‘Idan n maras ma’auru ne, to n² maras ma’auru ne,’ gaskiya ce: a ce n=2k+1, to n²=4k²+4k+1=2(2k²+2k)+1. Saboda haka asalin jimlar ma gaskiya ce.”
x-m-h1-09.thinking.1: Bambance jimla, akasinta da sakamakon juyawarta.
x-m-h1-09.thinking.2: Gina da bayyana tsarin misali mai saɓani.
x-m-h1-09.prereq.0: Ma’anar akasi, inwariant, da sakamakon juyawa na jimla
x-m-h1-09.prereq.1: Rubuta lambobi maras ma’auru da ma’auru da haruffa (2k, 2k+1)
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.prompt: Wane daga cikin mutanen ukun ne ya tabbatar da asalin jimlar daidai?
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta alaƙar abin da kowanne ɗalibi ya tabbatar da asalin jimlar (asali, akasi, ko sakamakon juyawa).
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.hint.1: Gwada da wata jimla dabam ko wannan alaƙar tana tabbatar da gaskiyar asalin jimlar.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.o.a: Sia. Tana aiki ga wasu lambobin ma’auru kaɗan, saboda haka gaskiya ce.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.r.a: Dole ne a bambance tsakanin gaskiya ga wasu misalai kaɗan da gaskiya ga dukkan lambobin halitta.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.o.b: Doyun. Idan akasin jimlar gaskiya ne, to asalin jimlar ma gaskiya ce.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.r.b: Bincika ko jimla da akasinta kullum suna da ƙimar gaskiya iri ɗaya. Za ka iya ƙirƙirar misali mai saɓani.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.o.c: Dukkansu ukun sun tabbatar da ita daidai. Hanyoyinsu ne kawai suka bambanta, amma sakamakon ɗaya ne.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.r.c: Ba ka bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko dalilan hujjojin ukun duk iri ɗaya ba ne?
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.o.d: Jihu. Idan sakamakon juyawar jimlar gaskiya ne, asalin jimlar ma gaskiya ce.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hukunci yana amfani da gaskiyar cewa jimla da sakamakon juyawarta suna da ƙimar gaskiya iri ɗaya.
x-m-h1-09.s.s1.explain: Jimla da sakamakon juyawarta kullum suna da ƙimar gaskiya iri ɗaya; saboda haka hujjar Jihu, wadda ta nuna cewa sakamakon juyawar gaskiya ne ga kowane cikakken adadi na halitta n, hujja ce ga asalin jimlar. Sia ta gwada wasu misalai kaɗan kawai, Doyun kuma ya tabbatar da akasin jimlar kaɗai. Ko da akasin jimlar gaskiya ne, hakan ba ya sa asalin jimlar ta zama gaskiya.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.prompt: Ka bayar da wata jimla dabam da ke nuna cewa tunanin Doyun (“akasin jimlar gaskiya ne, saboda haka asalin jimlar gaskiya ce”) ba daidai ba ne a koyaushe, sannan ka rubuta ƙimar gaskiyar asalin jimlar da akasinta.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin wata magana mai tsari “Idan ..., to ...” mai kama da jimlar yanzu.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.hint.1: Nemo misali mai saɓani da ke sa asalin jimlar ta zama ƙarya, sannan ka tabbatar cewa akasinta gaskiya ce.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Jimlar ... ƙarya ce, amma akasinta ... gaskiya ne.

x-m-h1-09.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka tabbatar cewa akasinta da gaske gaskiya ce?
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka bayyana cewa wannan misali yana nuna dalilin da tunanin Doyun yake kuskure?
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.model.0: Asalin jimlar “Idan siffa rhombus ce, to murabba’i ce” ƙarya ce (rhombus mai kusurwar da ba 90° ba misali ne mai saɓani). Amma akasinta “Idan siffa murabba’i ce, to rhombus ce” gaskiya ce. Saboda haka ba za a ce asalin jimlar gaskiya ce don kawai akasinta gaskiya ba.
x-m-h1-09.s.s2.model.1: “Idan x²=4, to x=2” ƙarya ce domin x=−2 misali ne mai saɓani. Amma akasinta “Idan x=2, to x²=4” gaskiya ce. Ko da akasinta gaskiya ce, asalin jimlar na iya zama ƙarya.

x-m-h1-10.title: Akwai aikin juyawa kuwa? Lokacin da yankin domain da codomain suka sauya
x-m-h1-10.goal: Tantance ko aiki yana da aikin juyawa bisa yankunan domain da codomain, sannan ka sake duba hukuncinka da sabon bayani don nemo dabara da domain na aikin juyawa.
x-m-h1-10.material: Ka yi la’akari da aikin f(x)=x²−2x+3. (x² na nufin x murabba’i ne. Hakanan ana iya rubuta wannan jimla a matsayin (x−1)²+2.) Domain da codomain suna sauyawa a kowane mataki.
x-m-h1-10.thinking.0: Sake duba hukuncinka yayin da sharuɗɗa suke sauyawa.
x-m-h1-10.thinking.1: Duba ko akwai daidaitaccen hulɗa tsakanin kowace ƙima guda ɗaya ta amfani da misali mai saɓani.
x-m-h1-10.thinking.2: Duba dabarar da ka samu ta amfani da maki guda.
x-m-h1-10.prereq.0: Ma’anar domain, codomain da zangon ƙimomin aikin
x-m-h1-10.prereq.1: Ma’anar daidaitaccen hulɗa tsakanin kowace ƙima guda ɗaya
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.prompt: Yanke hukunci duk lokacin da domain da codomain suka sauya, sannan ka sake duba hukuncin idan ka ga sabon bayani.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.hint.0: Zaɓi ƙimomin x daban-daban guda biyu, ka duba ko ƙimomin f sun yi daidai.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.hint.1: Idan domain da codomain suka sauya, da farko ka duba ko misalin saɓanin iri ɗaya yana cikin sabon domain.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.info: Wannan aikin f(x)=x²−2x+3 ne, inda domain da codomain duka su ne dukkan lambobin gaske.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.after: f(0)=3 da f(2)=3, saboda haka ƙimomin x daban-daban suna ba da ƙima ɗaya. Hakan yana nufin akwai ƙimomin x biyu da suka dace da y=3, saboda haka ba za a iya ayyana aikin juyawa ba. Dalilin shi ne babu daidaitaccen hulɗa tsakanin kowace ƙima guda ɗaya.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Akwai. Domin aiki ne da ke ba kowane x ƙimar y guda ɗaya tak.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan tunanin yana ɗauka cewa kasancewa aiki ya isa. Duba yanayin da ƙimomin x daban-daban suke ba da ƙima ɗaya.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Babu shi. Domin akwai yanayin da ƙimomin x daban-daban suke da ƙima ɗaya.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan tunani ne na nemo yanayin da shigarwa daban-daban suke da amsa ɗaya, sannan a yi amfani da shi a matsayin misali mai saɓani.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Babu shi sai a x=1 kawai.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan tunani ne na tantance kasancewar aikin juyawa a maki guda ɗaya kawai. Ka yi la’akari ko aikin gaba ɗaya yana da daidaitacciyar hulɗa tsakanin kowace ƙima guda ɗaya.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.info: Rage domain zuwa {x | x ≥ 1}, sannan ka sauya codomain ma zuwa {y | y ≥ 2}. Yanzu f aiki ne daga {x | x ≥ 1} zuwa {y | y ≥ 2}.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.ask: Wannan aikin yana da aikin juyawa?
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.after: Idan x≥1 ne, f(x)=(x−1)²+2 yana ƙaruwa yayin da x yake ƙaruwa, saboda haka ƙimomin x daban-daban suna da ƙimomin f daban-daban. Haka kuma, zangon ƙimomin y≥2 duka ne, don haka ya yi daidai da codomain. Saboda haka akwai daidaitacciyar hulɗa tsakanin kowace ƙima guda ɗaya, kuma yana da aikin juyawa.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Akwai. Domin a domain ƙimomin x daban-daban ba sa ba da ƙima ɗaya, kuma zangon ƙimomin ya yi daidai da codomain.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan tunani ne da ke duba domain da codomain tare.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.r.b: An yi amfani da dalilin matakin da ya gabata ba tare da canji ba. Duba ko x=0 yana cikin sabon domain.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Babu shi. Domin domain da codomain suna kama da mabambanta.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Ko da domain da codomain sun yi kama da mabambanta, aikin na iya zama mai daidaitacciyar hulɗa tsakanin kowace ƙima guda ɗaya. Ka sake tunanin sharuɗɗan da ake buƙata.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.info: A kira aikin juyawa f⁻¹. f(3)=6.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.after: Daga y=(x−1)²+2 da x≥1, ana samun x−1=√(y−2), saboda haka x=1+√(y−2). Idan aka musanya masu canji, f⁻¹(x)=1+√(x−2), kuma yankin ma'anarsa x≥2 ne, wato kewayon darajojin f. f⁻¹(6)=1+√4=3, wanda ya dace da f(3)=6. Ga sauran zaɓuɓɓukan, f⁻¹(6) zai zama −1 ko 1, don haka ba daidai ba ne.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Dole ne a rubuta yankin ma'anar f⁻¹, ba na f ba. Ka yi tunanin wane saitin ƙimomi ya kamata ya zama.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan zaɓin yana duba ko f⁻¹(6)=3 ta amfani da f(3)=6, kuma yana la'akari da yankin ma'ana.
x-m-h1-10.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Saka ƙima, ka duba ko f⁻¹(6) ya zama 3.
